results.question: May an administrator use an everyday account for privileged work?

response.answer: An administrator may not use an everyday human account for privileged work; privileged administrators must use a separate administrative account and a hardware security key, and the everyday account must not hold standing administrator privileges. [1]

citations.snippet: Privileged administrators must use a hardware security key and a separate administrative account; their everyday account must not hold standing administrator privileges.
citations.title: Password and Authentication Policy

claims.text: An administrator may not use an everyday human account for privileged work; privileged administrators must use a separate administrative account and a hardware security key, and the everyday account must not hold standing administrator privileges.

results.question: Who checks a manual account adjustment prepared by a teller?

response.answer: A manual account adjustment prepared by a teller must be checked by an independent authorized checker before posting. [1]

citations.snippet: All manual account adjustments require an independent checker before posting. The preparer records the reason, supporting evidence, affected account reference, and proposed amount. The checker verifies the evidence and authority.
citations.title: Branch Operations and Cash Handling Policy

claims.text: A manual account adjustment prepared by a teller must be checked by an independent authorized checker before posting.

results.question: How much of a CU 32 eligible travel meal can be reimbursed?

response.answer: A CU 32 eligible travel meal can be reimbursed in full, up to the CU 32 amount. [1]

citations.snippet: Example: CU 32 in eligible meals yields CU 32 reimbursement, not the CU 40 cap.
citations.title: Remote Work, Travel, and Expense Policy

claims.text: A CU 32 eligible travel meal can be reimbursed in full, up to the CU 32 amount.

results.question: Can the bank promise absolute confidentiality to a whistleblower?

response.answer: The bank cannot promise absolute confidentiality to a whistleblower. [1]

citations.snippet: The bank protects identities on a need-to-know basis but cannot promise absolute confidentiality.
citations.title: Whistleblowing and Protected Reporting Policy

claims.text: The bank cannot promise absolute confidentiality to a whistleblower.

results.question: What is the internal response target for a privacy request?

response.answer: The internal response target for a privacy request is 20 business days from the original receipt of the request. [1]

citations.snippet: The internal response target is 20 business days from original receipt.
citations.title: Data Protection, Privacy, and Retention Policy
